changes.comment: Behaviour change: mapSuccess and mapSuccessAsync now append every failure message to a supplied aggregatedErrors, in input order, even when some results succeeded. Previously a partial fold reported nothing to the aggregator and its failures were dropped silently. This brings the behaviour in line with the documented contract of the aggregatedErrors parameter; the returned Result is unchanged. A caller that passes an aggregator to a partial fold will now see messages it did not see before.
